points: 4 Pillars - tech leadership, digital transformation & GenAI
Learn From The Top Industry Professionals

Role Clarity: CTO vs CIO vs VP Engineering
CTO as Part of C-Suite & Boardroom

Metrics: Tech OKRs, North Star KPIs, Value Tracking

points: Evaluating ROI of Tech & Innovation Initiatives
Communicating Tech Value to CFO & Board

curriculum.title: Enterprise Delivery for CTOs

curriculum.title: Product & Technology Alignment for CTOs
points: Product Lifecycle: From Vision to GTM

curriculum.title: Capstone Project
points: Participants will act as CTOs developing a Technology Strategy & Execution Plan for a mid-to-large enterprise in digital transformation. The project includes aligning tech with business goals, modernizing infrastructure, exploring innovations (AI, GenAI, Blockchain), designing an agile org, ensuring cybersecurity and compliance, and defining a financial plan with measurable ROI. The final deliverable is a board-level presentation that unifies strategy, tech, and leadership into a clear roadmap for enterprise value.

content.title: Do I need to have prior Chief Technology Officer Program experience to enroll in the program?
content: This program is specifically crafted for seasoned professionals looking to advance their careers and expand their sectoral knowledge. It is intended for individuals with substantial industry experience.

content.title: What is the minimum system configuration required?
content: ## Minimum System Requirements for the Program:
- **Processor**: Any modern processor – Intel Core i3 (10th Gen or newer) / AMD Ryzen 3 (3000 series or newer) / Apple M1 or later

content.title: How many projects can I anticipate working on?
content: In the Chief Technology Officer Program, you will have access to case studies, simulations, and a Capstone Project to provide a better understanding of the CTO’s role.

content.title: What's the difference between case studies & projects?
content: Case studies are targeted towards concept validation and limited to only a single concept. However, projects are targeted to overall learning and are more of a combination of multiple topics.

content.title: What all topics are covered in the Chief Technology Officer Program ?
How much time does one need to spend?
content: Ideally, 30 minutes of preparation time is recommended each day, but students can allocate time according to their own schedules. They can choose to practice, read, or watch videos. Additionally, students must attend live classes on weekends. The schedule for these classes will be shared in advance.

content.title: What is the duration of the program?
content: The duration of the program is 10 months, every term is approximately 4-5 weeks long.

content.title: How's the Chief Technology Officer Program different?
content: ## This program is distinguished by three key elements:

- **Iterative Mastery Approach:** IITG's exclusive Iterative Mastery Approach ensures development through a step-by-step methodology, specifically designed to welcome individuals from diverse backgrounds. Whether you're seeking a lateral move in the industry or looking to broaden your skills, our program is tailored to empower you on your unique learning journey.

- **Versatile Skill Development Model:** IITG's unique framework ensures that every Tech Leadership  concept is taught in the context of real-world industry problems. Our program goes beyond theory, emphasizing practical case studies to prepare students for the challenges they'll face in the professional arena.
- **Accredian Career Center:** Aligned with our mission to cultivate the leaders of tomorrow, the Accredian Career Center empowers you to confidently launch your career.

content.title: Tell me more about Career Assistance?
content: Accredian provides career assistance through the Career Launchpad program. Students gain hands-on experience as leaders in their chosen field with rigorous resume and portfolio building sessions. The program also covers creating a strong online presence and developing top-notch interview skills.
